title: Compatibility Simulator + Operator Contracts for On‑Prem Upgrade Validation
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight compatibility simulator and a formal operator contract suite to validate Private (VPC/on‑prem) cluster upgrades without touching customer clusters. The simulator will replay CRD transitions, StatefulSet/Deployment upgrade patterns, schema migrations for the metadata DB, and certificate rotation flows. The operator contract checks will codify allowed invariants (e.g., API version compatibility, probe changes, leader-election semantics) that our orchestrator must preserve. Deliverables: 1) simulator binary + Docker image that can be run in CI and locally, 2) operator contract test suite (yaml assertions), 3) preflight probe collection & fix suggestions, 4) docs + runbook for dry-run validation in customers' air‑gapped environments.
comments: 2026-03-01 Maya Chen: Created ticket after postmortem from a staged upgrade that exposed a CRD conversion bug. Proposal attached in Confluence.

2026-03-03 Arjun Patel: Spike completed for a minimal simulator that replays CRD apply sequences and records Kubernetes API errors — prototype ran against kind clusters. Findings: 2 common failure modes around immutable fields and webhook version skew.

2026-03-04 Eng Review: Decided to add a DB schema dry-run layer to detect incompatible migrations that require offline transforms. Trade-off: increases scope and time but yields much higher safety for customers with large data footprints.
2026-03-06 Security: Flagged KMS/HSM interaction tests as required for security review — will provide synthetic KMS endpoints for simulator runs in CI.

2026-03-07 Design Feedback (Ruth Lopez): Suggested we represent operator contracts as canonical JSONSchemas and a small DSL for temporal invariants (eg. 'leader election must remain enabled during migration'). Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-08 Arjun Patel: Implemented preflight hooks that run the simulator in a customer's isolated VPC using ephemeral test workloads; initial PR open: refactor for pluginable checks. Link to PR in attachments.

2026-03-09 PM (Evan Brooks): Approved scope for MVP that includes simulator, contract suite, runbook, and CI gating. Follow-ups: integrate with console rollout gates and add telemetry for dry-run failures.

2026-03-10 Arjun Patel: Working on operator contract runner; next steps: add migration-cost estimator (expected downtime and peak memory) and wire simulator output into release gating dashboard. Blocking: need test fixtures for older operator versions from the artifact registry.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can run a full upgrade dry‑run for a 3-node kind cluster and surface fatal vs advisory failures
Operator contract suite catches at least 3 real incompatibility classes (CRD conversion, immutable field drift, webhook version mismatch)
CI job added to private-upgrades pipeline that runs simulator on every release candidate and fails gating on fatal assertions
Runbook published with steps for customers to execute dry‑run in air‑gapped environments, including artifact staging and KMS mocking
Telemetry emitted to Grafana with failure types and suggested remediations
